name: Rallly
title: Rallly: free Doodle alternative
hook: Doodle charges you eleven bucks a month to find a time that works for everyone. This app does it for free.

features.intro: No more group chat back and forth.
features.say: Create a poll, pick a few dates and times, and share the link.
Everyone votes yes, no, or if need be, and nobody needs an account.
Then see the best time at a glance, and finalize it.

install_line: It runs in any browser. Nothing to install.
caption:
Doodle Pro charges $11/month to find a time that works for everyone. Rallly does it for free 📅

✅ Create a poll with dates and times, share the link
✅ Everyone votes yes, no or if need be, no account needed
✅ See the best time at a glance and finalize it
✅ No spreadsheets, no credit card, free to start

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ The free hosted plan allows up to 3 open polls at a time and keeps each poll for 30 days. Unlimited polls, email invites and custom branding are on the paid Pro plan ($6/seat/month billed yearly). You can also self-host it. Doodle's $11/month is Pro billed annually ($15 if paid monthly)

Comment "MEET" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
